plugins.name: code-delegate
plugins.description: Delegate code implementation to local or cloud AI agents using isolated Git worktrees. Pluggable backends: opencode (local LLMs), claude (Anthropic API), codex (OpenAI). Features smart fallback, model escalation, and tiered security delegation.
